text: when an asset is exported as a prop where does it go, its not the models/props directory
resolution: Answered where prop exports land: File → Export → Prop creates no new artifact — it writes the placeable declaration (as:'prop', role, compiled rig skeleton, texture slots, lights) into the model's OWN package manifest at cart/editor/data/models/<category>/<name-slug>/manifest.json (AppFrame.tsx export handler, req_2718 'the manifest is the record'). The category folder comes from the package KIND, not the export — a prop-kind package lives in models/props/<name>/, but a build-kind package exported as a prop stays in models/build/<name>/; the palette scans manifests, not folders. Verified the user's recent prop exports are present under models/props (Model_59, pillz, speaker_001, vcr_dvd_combo_copy, Model_54/55/56). Offered a follow-up change if the folder should physically move under models/props on export. No code changed.
